definitions.explanation: A Japanese green tea made by roasting tea leaves at high temperatures. It has a distinctive brown color, toasty aroma, and mild flavor with low caffeine content.

examples.japanese: {食後|しょくご}にほうじ{茶|ちゃ}を{飲|の}む。
ほうじ{茶|ちゃ}はカフェインが{少|すく}ないので{夜|よる}でも{飲|の}める。
examples.english: Houjicha is low in caffeine, so you can drink it even at night.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}はほうじ{茶|ちゃ}ラテやほうじ{茶|ちゃ}アイスなど、ほうじ{茶|ちゃ}{味|あじ}のスイーツが{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Recently, houjicha-flavored sweets like houjicha lattes and houjicha ice cream have become popular.

notes: Can also be written as {焙|ほう}じ{茶|ちゃ}, though the hiragana form is more common. One of the main types of Japanese tea alongside {煎茶|せんちゃ} (sencha), {玉露|ぎょくろ} (gyokuro), {抹茶|まっちゃ} (matcha), and {番茶|ばんちゃ} (bancha). Its low caffeine and gentle flavor make it popular with children and the elderly. In recent years, ほうじ{茶|ちゃ} has become a trendy flavor for lattes, ice cream, and other sweets.
